description: The suite's first model_validation entry: does the entrant's material reproduce a REAL measured rubber? The reference is a natural-rubber specimen characterized independently by an ASTM D412 uniaxial tensile test (Azarniya & Rahimi 2022) and fit to a 3-term Yeoh model. The entrant reports its OWN uniaxial Cauchy stress vs stretch; the scorer compares to the measured curve. Uniaxial tension is chosen deliberately over a structural test (beam bending, etc.): it has no clamp, no bending, and no boundary-condition confound, so any gap is cleanly attributable to the constitutive law itself. This isolability is what makes it a valid model_validation target, where structural tests are not.

geometry.note: Homogeneous deformation; no frozen particle positions are needed. The entrant runs a uniaxial-stress protocol (one face pulled, transverse faces traction-free) or evaluates its constitutive law directly, since for homogeneous deformation the two coincide.

provenance.reference_formula: sigma(l) = 2 (l^2 - 1/l) [C10 + 2 C20 (I1-3) + 3 C30 (I1-3)^2], I1 = l^2 + 2/l; incompressible uniaxial Cauchy stress (see reference/yeoh_rubber.py)
provenance.source: O. Azarniya, G. H. Rahimi, Mechanics Based Design of Structures and Machines, 2022, doi:10.1080/15397734.2022.2121721. ASTM D412 uniaxial tensile test, 3-term Yeoh fit (Table 2; Fig 9 shows the fit tracks the measured curve).
regime_assumptions: the reference Yeoh curve stands in for the measured stress-strain data, which it tracks tightly (source Fig 9)
tolerance 15 percent budgets the ~6 percent experimental scatter (source: tensile std dev under 6 percent) plus constitutive-model tolerance
provenance.why_this_target: Structural tests such as a clamped-clamped beam are dominated by boundary-condition modeling (the clamp fixture stiffens the response by ~45 percent over ideal beam theory in this same specimen), so a sim-vs-experiment gap there cannot be attributed to the material. Uniaxial tension removes the boundary confound and makes the constitutive law the sole variable, which is the requirement for a clean model validation.
provenance.submission_format: results/<system>/m1_material_validation_v1/stress_strain.csv (or .parquet) with columns 'stretch' (>= 1) and 'cauchy_stress_pa' (load-direction Cauchy stress, transverse traction-free). Systems that cannot report stress do not submit and are marked NA.
